steps.en: Clone the repo, check out a release tag, boot the official images
steps.zh: 克隆仓库、检出发布 tag、拉起官方镜像

steps.en: Brings up the web app, metadata Postgres, Redis cache and Celery workers as one stack
steps.zh: 把 Web、元数据库、Redis、Celery 拉成一个服务栈

steps.en: Log in with the default admin account
steps.zh: 用默认管理员账号登录

steps.en: Register your warehouse with a SQLAlchemy connection string
steps.zh: 用 SQLAlchemy 连接串登记你的数仓

steps.en: Introspects the schema so tables and columns become selectable datasets
steps.zh: 内省 schema，把表和列变成可选用的数据集

steps.en: Build charts in the no-code explorer, save metrics, assemble dashboards
steps.zh: 在无代码 explorer 里做图、存指标、拼看板

steps.en: Runs each view as SQL against your warehouse and enforces row-level security
steps.zh: 每次查看都翻译成 SQL 在你的数仓上执行，并施行行级安全

value.en: Self-service dashboards over your warehouse while credentials and metric definitions stay in your own infrastructure
value.zh: 分析师自助出看板，而数仓凭据和指标定义都留在你自己的基础设施里
